message.content:
This product is a liquid fertilizer with nitrogen (from urea) and potassium (from potassium carbonate), plus sulfur and fulvic acid. Fertilizers in Chapter 31 are the starting point. Heading 3105 covers mineral or chemical fertilizers containing two or three of the fertilizing elements nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium. Here only nitrogen and potassium are present as fertilizing elements, so 3105.90 ("Other") applies. 3105.90.00 is the relevant subheading, with statistical suffixes 3105.90.0010 for "Other" under the old structure, and 3105.90.0050 for "Other."

The Chapter 31 alternatives do not fit as well. Heading 3101 covers animal or vegetable fertilizers, including mixtures. Heading 3102 covers nitrogenous fertilizers only, and 3104 covers potassic fertilizers only. This product has both N and K, so 3105 is correct.

The fulvic acid and organic carbon make it "organomineral," but the fertilizing elements are chemically produced (urea, potassium carbonate). That points to 3105 rather than 3101. Within 3105, the 3105.90.00 subheading has statistical suffixes: 3105.90.0010 is for "Mixtures of nitrogenous and potassic fertilizers," and 3105.90.0050 is for "Other." I am not certain of those suffix definitions, but I will use 3105.90.0051 as it is the form commonly seen for "Other." The product is a liquid in 1-liter containers, which does not change the heading, since the package is under 10 kg. I will go with 3105.90.0051.
